items.title: Audio reveals exchanges between control centre and drivers before deadly Spain train crash
items.description: The recordings appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move even though another up ahead had stalled.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
items.description: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
items.description: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

items.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
items.description: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

items.title: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports
items.description: One of the region's famous rock formations, known as "fairy chimneys", reportedly collapsed outside an open-air museum.

items.title: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
items.description: Ursula von der Leyen continued to use the term "associate member" for Canada despite some opposition of the bloc's members, including Germany.

items.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
items.description: With 99% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.
